summary.text: Taylor Collins is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 95 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Taylor Collins earned an M.P.A. and an M.B.A. from Drake University in 2021 and 2022, respectively.
His career experience includes owning a business and working as a farm manager.
Collins took office in January 2023 in District 95, succeeding Charlie McClintock, and defeated Jeff Poulter in the November 5, 2024 general election.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him as chair of the Higher Education committee and assigned to the House Appropriations, House Government Oversight, Natural Resources and House State Government committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Carrie Trevino in the general election.
